sasovo.title: FIRMS thermal anomalies, 6–14 Oct
sasovo.caption: Detections cluster over the main hall. Each square is a satellite pixel footprint (375 m or 1 km), not the exact fire position.
sasovo.credit: NASA FIRMS (VIIRS/MODIS thermal anomalies). Basemap as shown in FIRMS

sasovo.title: Sentinel-2, 4 Oct (before)
sasovo.caption: True colour, 10 m resolution.
sasovo.credit: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2026, processed with Copernicus Browser

sasovo.title: Sentinel-2, 9 Oct (after)
sasovo.caption: Haze and cloud cover the scene. No building-level change can be read at 10 m.
sasovo.credit: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2026, processed with Copernicus Browser

kaluga.title: FIRMS thermal anomalies, 6–14 Oct
kaluga.caption: No detections over the site. A fire that is small, short or under cloud can be missed, so this does not rule out damage.
kaluga.credit: NASA FIRMS (VIIRS/MODIS thermal anomalies). Basemap as shown in FIRMS

vladimir.title: FIRMS thermal anomalies, 6–14 Oct
vladimir.caption: No detections over the site. The FIRMS basemap predates the later buildings on the site.
vladimir.credit: NASA FIRMS (VIIRS/MODIS thermal anomalies). Basemap as shown in FIRMS

vladimir.title: Sentinel-2, 4 Oct (before)
vladimir.caption: True colour, 10 m resolution.
vladimir.credit: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2026, processed with Copernicus Browser

vladimir.title: Sentinel-2, 17 Oct (after)
vladimir.caption: Roof tone changes on two buildings of the central block. At 10 m this is consistent with the roof damage seen in higher-resolution imagery (RFE/RL via Militarnyi), not proof of it.
vladimir.credit: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2026, processed with Copernicus Browser

balakovo.title: FIRMS thermal anomalies, 6–14 Oct
balakovo.caption: Detections on and around the complex, most of them on open ground.
balakovo.credit: NASA FIRMS (VIIRS/MODIS thermal anomalies). Basemap as shown in FIRMS

balakovo.title: Sentinel-2, 5 Oct (before)
balakovo.caption: True colour, 10 m resolution.
balakovo.credit: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2026, processed with Copernicus Browser

balakovo.title: Sentinel-2, 15 Oct (after)
balakovo.caption: New burn scars on open ground around the complex match most FIRMS detections. Grass fires from debris and unrelated burning both fit. No building-level change at 10 m.
balakovo.credit: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2026, processed with Copernicus Browser

novosergievka.title: FIRMS thermal anomalies, 17–18 Oct
novosergievka.caption: No detections over the site. No cloud-free Sentinel-2 scene after the strike yet.
novosergievka.credit: NASA FIRMS (VIIRS/MODIS thermal anomalies). Basemap as shown in FIRMS
